messages:
alec.releases: Heads-up — Keystone private rollout is scheduled for tonight 02:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go and pin strategy.
maya.ops: @alec.releases thanks. Can you confirm the model variant we plan to pin? last check said v3.2-quant int8 fallback.
alec.releases: Correct. Plan: pin v3.2-quant on dedicated pool, keep v3.1-qa as immediate fallback. We want canary 5% for 30m then ramp.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary slice keystone-priv-1 -> v3.2-quant, target 5%, 12 instances. Monitoring hooks: latency|errors|quality-eval. Can revert with `rollback --slice keystone-priv-1`.
samir-sre: Quick note — KV cache format changes in v3.2. We added compatibility flag but performance regression seen in staging with cold cache. Watch 95p latency.
jenna-se: Added a small eval set for Keystones’ prompts. I’ll post results in 10m. If quality drops >3% on rouge-like eval we should hold.
oncall-ops: Oncall is set for the window. I can be paged. Have the playbook ready: pages to samir + maya, run automated rollback at 4x error rate.
deploy-bot: canary update: 10/12 instances healthy, 2 still warming. Metrics: 95p latency +7ms, error-rate 0.12% (baseline 0.09%), quality-eval +0.6% vs baseline. Logs: no KV-format errors.
maya.ops: Thanks. Samir — can you sign off on latency risk? If we see 95p > +30ms or errors >0.5% we auto-rollback.
samir-sre: Signed off for canary. I'll be watching the KV cache warmup; if tail latency spikes we hit manual rollback.
jenna-se: Eval looks good: precision drop 0.2%, recall +1.1% — overall quality within thresholds. thumbs up :thumbsup:
alec.releases: Ok team — proposal: proceed with ramp to 25% at 02:30 UTC, full ramp at 03:00 if no alerts. Pin config will lock v3.2-quant for keystone.* tenancy. Release notes updated: https://internal/release-notes/keystone-v3.2-quant
oncall-ops: A couple operational asks: ensure `--force-pin` flag requires two approvals; add a quick rollback slack alias for runbook steps.
maya.ops: Adding approvals: alec.releases + samir-sre required. I'll trigger ramp in 15m if no objections.
alec.releases: No objections. Proceed when ready. If anything looks off we fallback to v3.1-qa and open a postmortem.
deploy-bot: ramping to 25% now -> keystone-priv-1. Noted: rollback command available.
samir-sre: Watching. If 95p delta >30ms or error-rate >0.5% for 5min, I'll trigger manual rollback.
jenna-se: Leaving the eval job running — will post final pass in 20m.
alec.releases: Thanks everyone. Will follow up in morning with final rollout notes and changelog snippet for Keystone security team.
